newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - April 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - April 3.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Thursday's Daily Variety:
* Liam Neeson has emerged as the top choice for the starring role in the first new "Star Wars" prequel, sources said. He'll play a new character, the master Jedi knight.

* Peter Barton's resignation as Liberty Media CEO, announced quietly late Tuesday night, comes just as the Tele-Communications Inc's $5 billion cable programming confronts critical strategic and operational questions that could dramatically reshape it.
* Cinergi Pictures Entertainment Inc.'s board Wednesday approved the sale of its film library to Walt Disney Co, which will be announced Thursday.

* Disney's ABC is pulling the midseason comedy "Arsenio" starring Arsenio Hall from its schedule earlier than expected, although talks are under way between the network and producers DreamWorks Television to retool the show for next season.
* Samuel Jackson has closed a deal for a little more than $5 million to star in the Arnon Milchan-Mandeville Film co-production of "The Negotiator," sources said.
* Carlton Communications has completed the acquisition of Rank Film Distributors for 65 million pounds ($107 million).
* Brillstein-Grey Entertainment is in a financial spat with News Corp Fox Broadcasting Co over the comedy "MV24," which the production company was developing for the network's fall schedule.
